figurative_meaning_bn: দিনের বেলা; সূর্যোদয় থেকে সূর্যাস্তকাল পর্যন্ত; দিবাভাগ
figurative_meaning_en: Daytime; from sunrise to sunset; daytime portion
example_sentences_in_bangla: দিনমানে ঘরের ভিতর আলো কম পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: It is easier to work during the daytime.
Even during the daytime, less light enters the house.
note: This term is more literal than idiomatic, referring directly to the period of daylight in Bengali usage.
